content.what_it_is: MATLAB script generating bathymetry for the FUNWAVE-TVD subgrid_blocks_beach case at two resolutions: a coarse 500x30 planar beach and a fine 2000x120 grid carrying explicit obstacle blocks. Part 1 (L3-19): coarse grid nx_total=500 x ny_total=30 at dx=dy=2.0, uniform offshore depth 10.0, and for x > X_toe=560.0 a plane beach dep = dep_offshore - slope*(x - X_toe) with slope=0.025 (L16). Part 2 (L21-43): each coarse cell maps to a cell_m x cell_n = 4x4 fine block; a template dep_cell (zeros, L42) gets dep_top=-2.5 written into its obs_n x obs_m = 3x3 sub-window [n_obs1:n_obs2, m_obs1:m_obs2] computed by centered-offset formulas (L37-40, evaluating to rows/cols 1:3). Part 3 (L45-52): fine grid dep_full (n=120 x m=2000, L30-31) is filled by nearest coarse-cell replication dep_full(j,i)=dep(jj,ii) with jj/ii = floor block mapping (L48-50). Part 4 (L54-77): over a block region of ny_blocks=30 x nx_blocks=100 coarse cells starting at coarse index (m_start=400, n_start=1), each fine 4x4 patch is overwritten with local coarse depth plus the obstacle template (dep_cell_add, L64-65), while dep_sub_writeout accumulates one row per block: coarse i,j indices (cols 1-2, L70-71) then the 16 fine values at columns 2+(jj-1)*cell_n+ii (L72). Part 5 (L79-91): dep_level clamps negative fine depths to 0 (L79-80), then dep_sub re-averages dep_level over each 4x4 patch dividing by cell_m twice (L89). Output (L93-113): two jpg pcolor plots of -dep_full and -dep_sub to plots/, ASCII saves dep_sub_500x30.txt and dep_full_2000x120.txt (L109-110), and formatted table dep_sub_info.txt with '%5d%5d' + 16 x '%6.1f' per row (L111-113).
entities: nx_total, ny_total — coarse grid dimensions, L3-4
dx, dy — coarse grid spacing, L5-6
dep_offshore — offshore depth, L7
slope — beach slope, L8
X_toe — beach toe x-position, L9
x, y — coarse coordinate vectors, L10-11
dep — coarse depth array (ny_total x nx_total), L12
cell_m, cell_n — fine cells per coarse cell, L22-23
obs_m, obs_n — obstacle footprint in fine cells, L24-25
dep_bottom — 9999.0, defined L26 (never used)
dep_top — obstacle elevation value, L27
m, n — fine grid dimensions, L30-31
m_start, n_start — coarse start indices of block region, L32-33
nx_blocks, ny_blocks — block region extent in coarse cells, L34-35
m_obs1, m_obs2, n_obs1, n_obs2 — obstacle sub-window bounds in template, L37-40
dep_cell — 4x4 obstacle template, L42-43
dep_full — fine depth array, L45
jj, ii — fine-to-coarse index maps / template loop indices, L48-49 and L68-69
icount — block counter, L54, L67
m1, m2, n1, n2 — fine index bounds of current patch, L57-60 and L85-88
j_coarse, i_coarse — coarse indices of current block, L62-63
dep_cell_add — coarse depth + obstacle template patch, L64
dep_sub_writeout — per-block output table, L70-72
dep_level — fine depth clamped at 0, L79-80
dep_sub — patch-averaged coarse output depth, L89
tit — plot title string, L97, L105
fid — file handle for dep_sub_info.txt, L111

equations.ref: fine start column of block patch
patch average of clamped fine depth

unresolved: dep_bottom=9999.0 (L26) is defined but never referenced anywhere in the file
patch average at L89 divides by cell_m twice (/cell_m/cell_m) rather than cell_m*cell_n; numerically identical only because cell_m==cell_n==4 (L22-23)
column index 2+(jj-1)*cell_n+ii (L72) uses cell_n as the stride over ii which ranges 1..cell_m (L68-69); correct flattening only while cell_m==cell_n
obstacle sub-window formulas (L37-40) place the 3x3 window at rows/cols 1:3 of the 4x4 cell, i.e. offset toward the low-index corner, not symmetric — whether intended is not stated
block region starts at coarse column m_start=400 with nx_blocks=100 (L32, L34) reaching column 499, one short of nx_total=500 (L3); coverage intent not documented in this file

dep_cell_add and dep_sub_writeout are indexed without preallocation (L64, L70-72); dep_cell_add(:,:) on the left side requires the variable to already exist on first iteration in some MATLAB versions — no initialization appears in this file
